verdict.rationale: Bevy runs its own curated Assets page listing community-made assets, plugins, learning resources and apps, and its engine is built around a plugin model, so a package ecosystem exists. Nothing shows it is large or an integrated store comparable to commercial asset marketplaces. missing for 10: evidence of ecosystem scale (number or breadth of plugins/assets), ready-made 3D models or art packs specifically, an integrated in-engine store or install flow, independent hands-on corroboration of ecosystem depth.

support.subject: As a game developer, a large asset store or package ecosystem gives me ready-made models, tools, and plugins

citations.quote: A collection of third-party Bevy assets, plugins, learning resources, and apps made by the community.
